caption: The drawing features a single large eagle with outstretched wings dominating the composition, rendered in shades of brown and gold. The eagle's beak is open, and its eyes are facing forward. In its talons, the eagle holds a branch that is mostly brown with several gold leaves, extending horizontally beneath its body and to the right side of the image. On the eagle's chest, there is a shield that is red, white, and blue; the top part of the shield is blue with white stars, while the lower part consists of alternating vertical red and white stripes. The background of the drawing is plain and light in color, providing clear contrast to the eagle and its details.
title: Eagle
